description: This file defines a Google plugin for a larger application, including plugin registration, provider creation, and lazy loading of various Google AI services such as image generation, media understanding, and CLI backend.

classes.name: GoogleMediaUnderstandingProvider
classes.description: Extended MediaUnderstandingProvider with non-nullable handlers for image, audio, and video description and transcription.

methods.name: loadGoogleGeminiCliProvider
methods.description: Lazy loads and registers the Google Gemini CLI provider.

methods.name: loadGoogleImageGenerationProvider
methods.description: Lazy loads the Google image generation provider.

methods.name: loadGoogleMediaUnderstandingProvider
methods.description: Lazy loads the Google media understanding provider.

methods.name: loadGoogleRequiredMediaUnderstandingProvider
methods.description: Ensures the media understanding provider has all required handlers.

methods.name: createLazyGoogleGeminiCliProvider
methods.description: Creates a provider object for the Gemini CLI OAuth.

methods.name: createLazyGoogleImageGenerationProvider
methods.description: Creates a provider object for Google image generation.

methods.name: createLazyGoogleMediaUnderstandingProvider
methods.description: Creates a provider object for media understanding capabilities.
